changes.comment: BREAKING: Channel binding moves off the Team MCP onto a new core-hosted Channel MCP (issue #209 slice 8). The Feishu-specific Team MCP tools are removed WITHOUT compatibility aliases: `team.bind_group` -> `channel.bind_channel`, `team.transfer_channel_back` -> `channel.transfer_back`, and the create-time `team.create.bind_group` convenience is gone (bind a group after create instead). The new `channel` MCP server (the `channel-mcp` stdio shim) is injected into the dispatcher MCP set and forwards to core admin methods `mcp.channel.bind_channel` / `mcp.channel.transfer_back`; the old `mcp.team.bind_group` / `mcp.team.transfer_channel_back` admin methods are removed. Binding state, routing, and authorization stay core-owned (same ChannelBindingStore as before) — this is an MCP surface/ownership move only: targets are still Feishu group chats addressed by `chat_id`, and `reply`/`react` stay on the `feishu` MCP server. Rebuild: none required for stored state — channel bindings, Team records, and ledgers load unchanged. But any saved automation or prompt that calls `team.bind_group`, `team.transfer_channel_back`, or `team.create` with `bind_group` MUST switch to the Channel MCP `channel.bind_channel` (after create) / `channel.transfer_back`. The bundled dispatcher skill and base prompt are updated accordingly.
